name: EU Dividend Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the dividend is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments.

DIVI.name: Dividend In Scope
DIVI.definition: Dividend is in the scope of the directive.

DIVO.name: Dividend Out Scope
DIVO.definition: Dividend is out of the scope of the directive.

UKWN.name: Dividend Unknown
UKWN.definition: Unknown whether the dividend is in or out of the scope of the directive.
